scope: Windows use recorded root arrival origin; active tasks and realized model paths differ.
Each input stream has its own sealed complete prefix; not an atomic snapshot.
Queued requests without a native submit record have unknown cache evidence.
Native submit cache fields are retrospective service evidence, not entry-time features.
Worker intervals are clipped by the next observed launch, not exclusive GPU kernel cost.
Decode token deltas exclude output first produced during prefill.
Logical Host hits and hybrid-prefix gaps are not physical DMA or per-layer recomputation.
Transfer-stream totals and interval unions are not removable JCT or an oracle bound.
Partial windows are marked and must not be used as complete comparisons.
GPU CSV timezone is the recorded local America/Los_Angeles; runtime clocks are paired.
